name: AA Signin Widget
author: AA Extensions

sections.description:
AA Signin Widget offers a responsive sign-in form that can be added to your site using either a shortcode or a widget.

Features

  1. Responsive signin form with mobile-first design
  2. Multiple premium-style templates to choose from
  3. Live preview of the signin form in the admin panel
  4. Custom color pickers for background and button styles
  5. Brand logo upload support with WordPress media uploader
  6. hCaptcha integration with toggle and key input
  7. Shortcode support for embedding the signin form anywhere
  8. Clean and modern admin interface (single-page settings)
  9. Multilingual-ready with translation support
  10. Modular code structure (separate files for maintainability)

How to use it

  1. Install and activate the AA Signin Widget plugin from your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Admin > AA Signin Widget to configure settings like template, colors, logo, and hCaptcha.
  3. Choose a template and customize colors or upload your brand logo as needed.
  4. Enable hCaptcha by adding your site key and secret (optional).
  5. Use the shortcode `[signin]` or `[signinform]` on any page or post to display the signin form.
  6. Add the widget from Appearance > Widgets to display the signin form in your sidebar or footer.
  7. Save your settings and preview the signin form live in the admin panel.

Installation

  1. Download the AA Signin Widget plugin ZIP file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  4. Select the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  5. After installation, click Activate Plugin.
  6. Navigate to AA Signin Widget in the admin menu to configure the plugin.

Changelog

  1. Version 1.0.1 (2025-06-02)
    1. Added brand logo upload, color customization, and live admin preview
    2. Introduced premium template styles and hCaptcha support
    3. Improved responsiveness and separated plugin files for better maintainability
    4. Initial release with shortcode, widget, and basic login form
